'''Trecht''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] surveillance officer who was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was monitoring a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] operation at a location called [[Gorinth Brig|Cave 52]], on the orders of his superior, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tyrus (major)|Tyrus]].
